statement: For finite state and action spaces, an irreducible behavior-policy state chain with full action support, a full-column-rank feature matrix, invertible A, and Appendix B learning-rate/noise conditions, the unprojected off-policy Markovian TDC(lambda) iterates defined in Definition 7.1 converge almost surely.

quantifiers.probability: almost surely over the Markov sample path
quantifiers.lambda: eligibility-trace parameter in the algorithm; this reproduction tests 0.25, 0.55, and 0.85 and retains 0 only as a trace-off control
quantifiers.time: limit as t tends to infinity

required_algorithm: e_t = lambda gamma rho_(t-1) e_(t-1) + phi_t
nu_(t+1) = nu_t + alpha_t (rho_t delta_t e_t - phi_t phi_t^T nu_t)
theta_(t+1) = theta_t + beta_t (rho_t delta_t e_t - rho_t (1-lambda) gamma phi_(t+1) e_t^T nu_t)
finite_route_acceptance: all paper structural assumptions are audited
three nonzero lambda values and four deterministic seeds each execute without projection or clipping
the exact analytic fixed-point residual falls below 45 percent of its initial value in every nonzero-lambda cell
sampled A and b agree with independently derived analytic values within 14 percent relative error
all four negative controls are rejected for their intended reason
the fail-closed verifier rejects tampered evidence
theorem_verdict_rule: Finite paths are scoped corroboration only. VERIFIED requires an independently reconstructed symbolic derivation or proof certificate; a valid assumption-satisfying counterexample would yield FALSIFIED; otherwise the theorem-level verdict remains BLOCKED.
